name: Scapular Dip
steps: Support your body atop a dip station gripping the parallel bars with your arms locked completely straight and your legs hanging still beneath you.
Keeping your elbows locked, allow your torso to sink slightly downward as your shoulders shrug up toward your ears.
Press forcefully downward through your hands to depress your shoulder blades down away from your ears and elevate your body.
Pause briefly at the top of the scapular push, then lower smoothly back into the shrugged position without bending your elbows.
tips: Keep your elbows completely straight so all motion occurs strictly at the shoulder blades.
Brace your core lightly to keep your body still rather than swinging your legs.
